title: Evaluating Machine Perception of Indigeneity: An Analysis of ChatGPT's Perceptions of Indigenous Roles in Diverse Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Generating sentence completions using ChatGPT for prompts featuring either 'Indigenous' or 'White/Caucasian' individuals across three scenarios (fields, technology store, subway), and evaluating the outputs for stereotypes, exoticized language, and paternalistic tropes using human ground-truth annotation and LLM self-labeling.
